meta.title: PO Export & Search/Filter: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify PO Export is refused or absent.
Use PO Search/Filter to find events by PO number as a user without the Buyer role.
Repeat PO export and PO-number search as a Buyer and verify the actions are available.
Compare the two users' results in the same tenant.
